name: Offline Earnings UI
summary: Editable offline-earnings reward dialog with claim and x5 reward buttons, sample 67k Grass text, green stud styling and burst artwork.
install: Create a ScreenGui under StarterGui and import OfflineEarnings inside it. Position the Frame for your layout; preview clones used AnchorPoint (0.5, 0.5) and Position (0.5, 0.5). Connect Claim and x5 controls to your own server-authoritative earnings and purchase logic. No offline tracking or saving is bundled.
limits: Static layout inspected in Studio Play on temporary clones at 1325 x 761; panel visibility and scroll positions were set manually. No gameplay handlers are included. No mobile/gamepad testing. Native files are unchanged. Displayed reward values are examples; claiming, multipliers and persistence are not implemented.
credit: Supplied filename retains TU VIP wording; no independent author or membership/license inference is made.
verification: Static layout preview in Studio Play on temporary clones; no original scripts are present. Panel visibility and scrolling were set manually, not by working navigation. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Viewport 1325 x 761; desktop only.
